name: unifiedcron
description: A developer tool that centralizes cron jobs from many platforms into one dashboard

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @unifiedcron/shared build && pnpm --filter @unifiedcron/database build && pnpm --filter @unifiedcron/integrations build && pnpm --filter web build && pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter worker build
scripts.test:ci: pnpm build:services && pnpm type-check && pnpm lint && pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:integration
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter web lint && pnpm --filter api lint && pnpm --filter worker lint
scripts.type-check: pnpm --filter web type-check && pnpm --filter api type-check && pnpm --filter worker type-check
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter @unifiedcron/shared build && pnpm --filter @unifiedcron/database build && pnpm --filter @unifiedcron/database migrate
scripts.build:services: pnpm --filter @unifiedcron/shared build && pnpm --filter @unifiedcron/database build && pnpm --filter @unifiedcron/integrations build && pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter worker build
